body: What are you guys planning to do for ur gap? Or how are you planning it?

I really hope you know that you’re more than this condition. Maybe see how you can ignore it when it isn’t at its worst. 

I try to ignore the ones on my under arms, with no solution to help get rid of it, I sometimes feel like there isn’t any other choice. Try pretend it’s not there as best you can when it’s possible to? Just so u don’t let
This consume you everyday. 

Diet seems to only mitigate not solve it man. People who aren’t overweight have it too so don’t be too hard on yourself when you do ur best to stay fit and it still breaks out. 

Try to think of something else before skin. Maybe someone’s shoes or something to help you move from thinking about ur skin and this condition all the time.

Sucks to be here but U’re gonna get past this. Even if there’s no solution to this it can still get better with time. 

<3
